dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 29, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Monday MLB Recap: Offense Takes Center Stage**

In a day filled with explosive performances, several hitters made their mark across the league. Ronald Acuña Jr. and Michael Harris II led the Atlanta Braves to an 8-3 win over the Cincinnati Reds, with Acuña Jr. contributing a key hit that scored two runs. Meanwhile, Curtis Mead's two-run homer helped the San Diego Padres edge the Washington Nationals 7-5.

On the mound, several pitchers stood out, with Justin Wrobleski throwing a complete game shutout for the Los Angeles Dodgers in a 4-2 win over the Philadelphia Phillies. Wrobleski allowed just one run on one hit while striking out nine. MacKenzie Gore also excelled, pitching 6.1 scoreless innings for the Texas Rangers in a 9-1 win over the Kansas City Royals.

In other games, Ezequiel Tovar hit two home runs for the Colorado Rockies in an 8-6 win over the San Francisco Giants, while J.P. Crawford also hit two home runs for the Seattle Mariners in a 7-6 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks. Ben Rice had a four-hit game for the New York Yankees in an 8-2 win over the Athletics.
